title: Reducing Misuse of MediShield Claims by Allowing Claims for Some Outpatient Treatment
what_it_is: Reducing Misuse of MediShield Claims by Allowing Claims for Some Outpatient Treatment

sections.label: Outpatient subsidies, MediSave, MediShield, MediFund
sections.summary: MOH has raised outpatient subsidies, expanded MediSave use, and MediShield Life and MediFund cover costly outpatient treatments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Over the past few years, the Ministry of Health (MOH) has enhanced Government subsidies for outpatient services and drugs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Patients can receive up to 70% subsidy at Specialist Outpatient Clinics (SOCs) and up to 75% subsidy for drugs and medication.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Additional support is provided for Pioneer Generation (PG) patients who receive a further 50% off their subsidised outpatient bills.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We have also expanded MediSave use for outpatient treatments, including outpatient scans and chronic disease treatment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Singaporeans who are 65 years and above also have the flexibility to use up to $200 of MediSave every year to pay for their outpatient treatments at public healthcare institutions and participating Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS) and general practitioner clinics.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MediShield Life currently covers a number of costly outpatient treatments, such as kidney dialysis and chemotherapy treatment for cancer.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Beyond Government subsidies, MediShield Life and MediSave, MediFund assistance is also available for low-income Singaporeans who require further financial support to pay for their outpatient bills.

sections.label: MediFund safety net for low-income families
sections.summary: Low-income families needing help beyond subsidy, MediShield Life and MediSave can apply for MediFund through medical social workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: For the low-income families that Mr Ong Teng Koon spoke about, the best way to help them is really to make sure that there is a safety net, and this is what we provide through MediFund.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: So, for low-income families, after the Government subsidy has been applied, and after MediShield Life and their own MediSave, if that is still not enough and they need further assistance, they can apply for MediFund through the medical social workers.
